Magnetic Loop Antenna Mazzoni Stealth Datasheet

Info: Widely used antenna from the manufacturer Mazzoni, Italy.
Conductor: Aluminium rectangular tube, outside 60mm x 20mm, wall 2 mm, painted gray.
Capacitor: Air capacitor, aluminum, painted gray
Environment: Unknown, values from datasheet.

Measurement Info

It is not clear to me what is meant by the bandwidth specified in the datasheet. There are different bandwidth definitions that could be intended here.
I did not receive an answer to my inquiry to the manufacturer about how the bandwidths were determined and which bandwidth was meant exactly.

Final Remarks

The efficiency calculated from the bandwidth partially exceeds 100%, which cannot be physically correct.
Either the specifications are wrong, or I am calculating it incorrectly.

I reluctantly include obviously incorrect numbers in this overview. At this point, however, I have no other choice.
